en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4335 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The expiation for gatherings is to say upon leaving them:

'Glory be to your Lord (azj), the Lord (azj) of Honor, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And all praise is due to Allah (swt), the Lord (azj) of the worlds.' (Surah As-Saffat 37:180-182)."
